dataset_scope: Seven Chinese cities; processed figure-supporting data, not raw GPS/trip records

FigSI5.Distributions of average daily dr.unit_note: Zenodo/OpenAIRE data dictionary lists unit as '-' for FigSI5 distance summary; do not annualize or label km/day until the figure axis/method confirms unit.

interpretation_flags: Fig1e is a CDF of daily driving distance; its data dictionary explicitly specifies km.

FigSI5 describes distributions of average daily driving distance by city and vehicle type, but the data dictionary lists the unit as '-'; do not assume km/day until the figure axis/method confirms it.
Fig1e Private car P50 in uploaded CSV is 37 km, while the article narrative reports a median of about 30 km; discrepancy unresolved.
Fig1e P100 values for all six vehicle categories are close to 500; possible ceiling/truncation should be checked against processing methods before interpreting maxima.
FigSI5 contains 42 all-empty separator rows; 42 valid rows remain after dropping only fully empty rows on the analysis copy.
Neither CSV separates BEV from PHEV, includes a 2023 Beijing-specific sample, provides individual vehicle observations, or enables calculation of alpha_P.
Neither file directly provides annual mean VKT; do not multiply a median daily distance by 365 and call it annual mean mileage.
download_provenance: Files were downloaded by the user through a browser and uploaded to the conversation. Python independently verified their MD5 values against Zenodo's published values and computed SHA-256. Python did not download these files from Zenodo.
repository_status: The audit metadata is archived here. Original CSV bytes are not yet committed to this repository.
